decision.title: The XSLT 4.0 test driver (packet )
decision.summary: sxml-xslt-test is a sibling of sxml-qt4 that reads the XSLT 4.0 test catalog, decides applicability and scope, plans each case's invocation, and runs a 154-case slice against a baseline.

body.p: . tests/xslt/driver/, the developer tool sxml-xslt-test, public API only.

item.p: A sibling, not a mode of sxml-qt4: the XSLT catalog has its own namespace, schema and semantics (dependencies as elements in <dependencies>, stylesheets, invocations, assert over the result document), so its catalog, applicability and commands are new modules; it links sxml_qt4_driver_library for documents (a document loaded by sxml_qt4_document_load with its catalog namespace switched to http://www.w3.org/2012/10/xslt-test-catalog), the QT4 environment reader (sources, params, resources, collections, collations, schemas), suite paths, test lists, reasons and the run report (spec "XSLT40").

Reading: a ref looks in the test set, then catalog.xml; every <dependencies> child is a dependency whose type is its local name. Names (params, initial template, mode, function) are xs:QNames: a prefix bound by the element, Q{uri}local as an EQName, an unprefixed name in no namespace, #default/#unnamed kept as keywords. initial-function gives CALL_FUNCTION, else initial-template CALL_TEMPLATE (one case also names a mode: ignored, listed), else APPLY_TEMPLATES. <output> of <test>, else of the environment.

Applicability: spec tokens XSLTnn / XSLTnn+ (case replaces set; no spec = every version, as ); other dependencies match their whole value against a table (xslt_applicability.c): features higher_order_functions, namespace_axis, serialization, built_in_derived_types, HTML5, XPath_3.1 (XSLT 3.0's optional 3.1 support), streaming-fallback; English numbering, AD/ISO calendars, every year_component_values phrase, the normalization forms, UTF-8, HTML 5, on-multiple-match recover, package_version_resolution highest_version (until 4.16 decides), enable_assertions, codepoint collation, any maximum_number_of_decimal_digits. Not: dynamic_evaluation, disabling_output_escaping, numbering combinations, the non-goals. Then the environment (source validation, XInclude, XML 1.1 sources, schemas, unknown collations) and posture-and-sweep tests. Scope (): spec matches, group (directory under tests/) not strm or sandp, no required non-goal feature. Measured: 13,867 cases resolve, 8,387 applicable, 8,728 in scope (: about 8,700).

Plan (xslt_test_run.h): principal module = first non-secondary module of <test>, else of the environment, else the defines-stylesheet source (16 cases); a package is RESOLVED_PACKAGE, a stylesheet TEXT with base URI file:///SUITE-PATH; other modules are served by the resolver; static params go to the stylesheet configuration, others are stylesheet parameters; role "." is the global context item; delivery SERIALIZED (serialize="yes"), RAW (tree="no"), TREE (tree="yes"), else DEFAULT; base output URI from output file=, else file:///TEST-SET-DIRECTORY/output/TEST-CASE/; result documents to sxml_xslt_result_document_collector, messages to the trace sink. Assertion semantics for the checks are in xslt_assertion.h (assert with the result document as context item, $RESULT-VAR bound for raw results).

Run: not applicable is not-run "skip: ..."; assert-warning or assert-posture-and-sweep anywhere is not-run "unsupported: KIND"; an unknown or malformed assertion or no principal module is an error; all else is not-run "XSLT not implemented" until 4.15 implements xslt.h. 4.15 (or a follow-up) adds the execution: a processor per case with the QT4 limits, the plan applied, the assertions checked.

Slice: tests/xslt/slice.txt, 154 in-scope applicable cases spread over the twelve core sets of the Phase 4 gate; ctest xslt/slice against tests/xslt/slice-baseline.txt (0 until XSLT runs); xslt/list_slice keeps them resolving.

sources.source: xslt40-test cases that resolve, are applicable and are in scope
